description: This PHP source file defines the SaveLocationController class within the OrangeHRM admin plugin. It manages the rendering of location-related components, handles permission setup, and interacts with country services to populate location data for the front-end.

classes.name: SaveLocationController
classes.description: Controller class responsible for managing location save/edit operations within the admin plugin. It prepares the Vue component with necessary properties and handles permission setting.

methods.name: preRender
methods.description: Prepares the view by creating a Vue component for location either in edit mode or save mode, adds country data to the component, and sets permissions.

methods.name: getDataGroupsForCapabilityCheck
methods.description: Returns an array of data groups required for capability permission checks, specifically related to 'locations'.
